gen-dafont-ozone-gf-hanuman: Ozone draws everything with one fixed pen, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase, gives that rigid line some tradition; try the heading a few sizes larger so the two stay distinct.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-kadwa: Generous x-height and open-ended curves make Kadwa read like a warm, editorial voice. Ozone is best at a single technical thread of uniform line, while Kadwa does its best work in running text as a classic serif.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text enters every curve with a big visible lead-in. Ozone is best at a line that never swells or tapers, and Noticia Text, a serif with lowercase filling most of the letter height, is best at dignified, literary paragraphs.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened wide. Piazzolla, a classic serif, would carry a long stretch smoothly beneath Ozone, whose vinyl-cut single line width keeps the heading crisp and technical.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-pridi: Pridi sets its small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized, with generous space between curve ends and stems. Pridi, a text serif, is the warm half, and Ozone's letters bent from one length of wire make the strongest single quality: a crisp, mechanical foil.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional and refined, its counters spilling into the surrounding space beside a big x-height and stubby ascenders. And Ozone, with no pinched joins or swelling bowls, gives it a strikingly mechanical partner.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-slabo-13px: Ozone draws every curve without any thick-to-thin shift. Slabo 13px, a bookish serif with large open counters, gives that stiff heading a dignified, readable partner underneath.
gen-dafont-ozone-switzer: Technical in spirit, Ozone holds its wire-like line with capitals barely above the lowercase. Switzer, a plain sans with tubular letterforms and a tall waist line, sits beneath it with approachable Swiss ease.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-esteban: Refined and classic, Esteban keeps its thin strokes only slightly slimmer than its stems, with oversized lowercase beside its capitals. Plakkaat's flat, unswelling curves hit heavier and bolder than that.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-faustina: Faustina brings an open-jawed c and gently thinning bowls. Plakkaat's closed, heavy letters against this serif's openness is the pair's strongest quality, a bold slab beside something airy.
